changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO achievement (id, code, name, description, category, icon_url, criteria_json, xp_reward, is_active, reward_type, created_at, updated_at) SELECT id, REPLACE(LOWER(name), ' ', '_') as code, name, description, 'GENERAL', icon_url, criteria_json, 0, true, 'BADGE', created_at, updated_at FROM badge;

INSERT INTO account_achievement (id, account_id, achievement_id, progress_value, status, created_at, unlocked_at, updated_at) SELECT uuid_generate_v4(), account_id, badge_id, 1, 'UNLOCKED', earned_at, earned_at, earned_at FROM account_badge;
